free_tier.stated: no free tier; Xata Cloud starts with a 14-day free trial, then pay as you go
free_tier.notes: the open-source core is free to self-host and is a different product from Xata Cloud

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the trial bills by branch-hour and GB-month rather than capping an object

retention.stated: the trial ends after 14 days; a credit card is required after it to keep the database

egress.terms: not published on the pricing page; recorded as a gap

interface_detail: Postgres wire protocol plus an HTTP data API and a CLI
tooling: psql and any Postgres client; the xata CLI
chaining: no path: a 14-day trial cannot anchor a workload that has to outlive a fortnight

limits.value: 14-day trial; the always-free 15 GB tier is retired

identity_cost.detail: email for the trial; a credit card after it to stay on pay as you go

confidence_note: the pricing page states the 14-day trial in its own FAQ answer; the 15 GB free tier that aggregators still print is not on the page.

evidence.proved: 'Open source is free forever. Xata Cloud starts with a 14-day free trial. Add a credit card after the trial to keep using Xata on Pay As You Go'; micro instance USD 0.012/hr, storage USD 0.28/GB-month

price_per_tb_month: USD 0.28/GB-month storage, micro compute USD 9/month equivalent
notes: Any corpus that still lists Xata's 15 GB always-free tier is describing a plan that no longer exists.
